'''Chimal''' was one of Empress [[Radhanan]]'s children.

== Activities ==
She carried out a number of plots to kill her sister [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]].{{ref/book|11|11}} She was murdered with the rest of her family by [[Semirhage]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
